of the viewport height: smaller draws more triangles.

visibility_buffer.description:
Whether the camera's clusters shade through the visibility buffer,
each pixel once; false shades them as they draw,
which was faster on the integrated GPU measured. Omitted, false.

SceneWater.description:
Water settings: how terrains' water looks (its color, clarity,
sediment and the share of the wind's waves it shows) and how it draws
and runs live; its movement and foam come from its state, under the
scene's wind as the terrain upwind shelters it.

clarity.description: The meters of water through which half the light passes.

color.description: The color deep water scatters back, linear.

live_cell.description:
The meters across the live window's cells: the square
`simulated` asks for runs in cells this size, each starting from
the settled water's cells around it.

sediment.description:
How strongly the fine sediment water carries scatters light, per
meter: light passing through fades by it as well as by what the
water's clarity takes, and the water's body scatters back
`sediment_color` by the sediment's share of the two; 0 none.

sediment_color.description: The color the water's sediment scatters back, linear.

simulated.description:
The meters across the square around the camera over which
rivers run live as the shallow-water equations say, in cells
`live_cell` across, starting from their water as it settled
there and taking the settled water's past its edges; 0 none, the
settled water standing everywhere.

simulation_cell.description:
The meters across the cells water settles in: the cook makes the
settled water's records at this size.

subdivision_error.description:
Pixels the water's drawn triangles may stray from its surface,
seen from the detail eye: each terrain's water subdivides a tree
of its own, splitting its leaves straying more and merging those
whose halves would not, as the ground's does. Smaller draws more
triangles. The water draws as many pixels over its surface as
this and the ground's own error together, so the ground drawn
under it never hides it.

subdivision_leaves.description:
The most leaves each terrain's water's subdivision draws, 28
bytes each on the GPU: past them leaves split no more, counted,
and the water there stays coarser.

wind_waves.description:
The share of the wind's waves terrains' water shows, from 0 to 1:
their slopes, their heights and how far they fold, whitening
their crests, scale by it, and the variance of their slopes,
which roughens the water, by its square; the sea keeps all of its
own. At 0 still water is a calm mirror, and running water shows
only what its current and its bed raise (the waves the bed holds,
boils, waves standing about what it flows past).

gusts.description: How strongly gusts traveling with the wind vary its push.

velocity.description: Horizontal velocity: x and z, meters per second.

dark.description: The share of rooms that stay dark.

dusk.description: The sun's elevation, degrees, around which rooms switch on.

enabled.description: Whether lit windows switch on room by room as the sun sets.

spread.description: How far either side of `dusk` rooms' elevations spread, degrees.

distance.description: How far cells load, as a multiple of each grid's range.

enabled.description: Whether streamed items load at all: off unloads every cell.

frozen.description:
Whether cells stay as they are, loading and unloading nothing, for
captures and inspection.

prefetch.description: The seconds ahead along the camera's motion cells load early for.

spawns_per_frame.description:
The entities a frame spawns at most, pacing loads: cells spawn
whole, and at least one a frame.

unload.description:
How much farther than that every source must be before a loaded
cell unloads, as a multiple.

Stamp.description:
A local edit: full strength within `radius` meters of `center`, fading
out over `falloff` meters beyond.

center.description: Terrain-local meters along x and z.

falloff.description: Meters beyond the radius over which it fades out.

op.description: What it does where it reaches.

radius.description: Meters around the center at full strength.

StampOp.description:
What a stamp does where it reaches: raise or lower heights by meters,
level them toward a height, or cut holes in the terrain.

oneOf.description:
Cells whose centers lie within the radius are holes: no surface
draws or collides there.

SteepLayer.description:
The material covering a surface's steep ground, painted over every
biome and layer: none of it where the ground's slope is the first of
`slope`'s degrees from level, all of it from the second, smoothly
between, on the smooth surface through the ground's samples
([`SampleShape`]). Samples hold it as they hold their other materials;
renderers decide it again at every point of the ground level-0 samples
shade from the slope there, so its edges follow the ground's form, not
its samples, and farther away show it as level 0's samples hold it,
averaged.

material.description: The material covering it, an ID of the surface's materials.

slope.description: The slopes its share rises between, in degrees from level.

StepsLayer.description:
Rock steps: ground too steep to hold soil bares its rock, which
breaks along its bedding planes, lying level, into treads and down
its joints into risers, the ledges broken where joints cross them. A
step runs down the slope its height over the slope's tangent: steps
fade out as that run nears two samples, the shortest the samples
resolve, and each riser spans two of them.

cover.description:
The share of the ground its ramps allow that its patches cover:
0 none, 1 all.

height.description: Meters from one tread up to the next.

joints.description: Meters between the joints breaking its ledges.

patches.description:
Meters across the patches it lies in, each with its bedding
shifted from the next one's.

seed.description: Picks the pattern of its patches, bedding and joints.

slope.description:
Slopes (degrees) over which it fades in, none at the first and
all from the second: from the steepest soil rests at, its angle
of repose, to where the ground bares its rock.

wetness.description:
Wetness indexes over which it fades in, none at the first and all
from the second: falling, so it keeps to spurs and planar slopes
and leaves the hollows water gathers in to the soil and debris
filling them.

SurfaceProjection.description:
How a surface material's textures lie on the ground: from above, or
on steep ground also from the side, so cliffs don't stretch them.

TerrainPrefetch.description:
Names a place the camera may be sent to, such as a spawn point:
while the view wants nothing, the terrain tiles a camera there wants
load into memory, and stay there while it is named, so the camera
sent there finds them at once.

reach.description:
Each level's tiles within this many times its range; 2 is what a
camera there loads.
